mapper.select: SELECT revision.subject_id, revision.permission_version, binding.role_code FROM organization_access.platform_subject_authorization revision INNER JOIN organization_access.subject_identity subject ON subject.subject_id = revision.subject_id INNER JOIN organization_access.platform_role_binding binding ON binding.subject_id = revision.subject_id WHERE revision.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND subject.status = 'ACTIVE' AND binding.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY binding.role_code
SELECT subject_id, login_name, password_hash, status, version, created_at FROM organization_access.subject_identity WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_access.tenant_membership WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'ENABLED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding binding INNER JOIN organization_access.subject_identity subject ON subject.subject_id = binding.subject_id WHERE binding.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR' AND binding.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subject.status = 'ACTIVE' AND binding.subject_id <> #{subjectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.platform_role_binding (binding_id, subject_id, role_code, status, version, created_at) VALUES (#{bindingId}, #{subjectId}, #{roleCode}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_access.platform_subject_authorization SET permission_version = organization_access.platform_subject_authorization.permission_version + 1, version = organization_access.platform_subject_authorization.version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId}
